description: V1 smell controls (revised 2026-07-11): long-method microbenchmarks adapted from real, MIT-licensed annotated examples in the SmellyCodeDataset (Sadik, Honda Research Institute Europe, https://github.com/HRI-EU/SmellyCodeDataset, Python/SmellyAnnotated). Each function inlines the multi-responsibility structure of an original class method (Chef.long_method, Shop.long_method, Cashier.long_method, Customer.long_complaint_method, Shop.order_with_unnecessary_details) into a single self-contained, typed function to fit the V1 pipeline's isolated-function format. Not part of the formal ESBMC metrics.
